source.previewGeometry: Illustrative origin/end/width/duration in scene pixels and milliseconds. Parent game is not imported.

design.cause: The blade tip releases the leading edge along its instantaneous tangent. A tapered curved front carries a narrow bright pressure marker and a dark expansion immediately behind it. The tip settles independently after release.
design.light: Pressure visualized with false-color contrast. No lens ghost or bloom.
design.sound: A synthesized broadband shear and short bipolar pressure impulse share the release crossing. Audio enable resets the visual timeline and waits for release.
design.galleryAudio: window.__gallerySfx.activateFromGesture() / stop(). Native iframe uses its own audio button. verify query always mutes.

checks.nativeReadback: Intel Iris Xe, Vulkan. 384x176. Compared against post-expiry baseline on light and dark backgrounds. Normal and giant: changed-pixel leading edge advances at phases .2/.5/.8. At phase .5 normal span 44–45 px and giant span 91–92 px. At 1.15 both match post-expiry. Native offscreen, not a browser observation.
